568bc755fedfbd58.why: I ran onceTag over every ability in all 6 lists. Branch 1 copies a BSData tag that starts "Once/Twice per" and drops the " · …" suffix, e.g. Bomb Squig "Once per turn, twice per battle, per unit", Supreme Kunnin’ "Once per phase, per army", Twisted Sorceries "Once per battle · Psychic" → "Once per battle". Branch 2 copies the text’s own words: a leading "Once per turn" (Harpoon Barbs, Malign Presence) or a parenthesised "(Once per battle, per army)" (Archslaughterer, Umbralefic Crystal). It adds ", per army" only when the text says "one model from your army with this ability" (Will of the Hive Mind → "Once per battle round, per army"; BSData tags the same wording on Direct the Slaughter "Once per battle round, per army"). No limit is invented. Latent gaps, and they leave text out rather than add to it, so this stays ok: an unparenthesised "Once per battle" after a "… model only." sentence gets no tag (enhancements Incandaeum and Null Nodules, neither in any list), and a tag-less text "Once per turn, twice per battle, …" would be cut to "Once per turn". Bomb Squig has its tag, so it is not affected.

I tested perBattle on every ability, army rule, detachment rule, enhancement and stratagem in data.js:
- Bomb Squig "Once per turn, twice per battle, per unit" → n 2, per unit.
- Makari "Once per battle, per army" and Archslaughterer, Umbralefic Crystal, Morgog’s Finkin’ Cap, Mysterious Guardian "(Once per battle, per army)" → n 1, army.

- Insane Bravery "cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle" → 1.
Per-turn and per-phase limits are never counted. Note for the caller: the armyWide=true argument overrides an explicit "per unit" (perBattle(Higher Imperatives, true).army is true). f8d2d30cbccdf988.why: EFFECT: "roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has DEFF DREAD: On a 4+, do not remove that model". The gist has no trailing "…" but drops the +3 modifier, which changes how often the 4+ succeeds. The rest matches ("if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase"; "When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed"). The fix adds "…" rather than restating the +3 clause, so it doesn't have to decide what the ~~ markup on DEFF DREAD means.

f8e01071749e457b.why: Labels: ASSAULT, [ASSAULT], unit rule, and "assault shooting" (bold only inside the Assault text itself, where it is not linked); the [ASSAULT] rule is the one that grants assault shooting (10.05).

fcc098e5fb2c4ac7.why: WHEN: "when an enemy unit has shot"; TARGET: "One friendly FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks"; EFFECT: "Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit." The gist puts the trigger first, shortened (the phase is left out, as in the allowed "After shooting:" example). "hit yours" comes from the TARGET, and "only at that enemy unit" = "can only target that enemy unit". Nothing added.

fd21ae46923c1f3a.why: “In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, this model’s ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.” The footnote keeps the condition (used, your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot) and adds no duration or scope of its own.
